"""Deterministic pipeline status of a work item (contract: scratch/dashboard-model-contract.md).

Backlog → Doing → PR review → PR fix → Merge → Integration → Main → Deployed, or Dropped.
`blocked` and Your call are tags, never statuses.
"""

from __future__ import annotations
from orchestra_dashboard.common import STATUSES as STATUSES
from orchestra_dashboard.common import CLOSED as CLOSED

import re

from wi_common import REPOS, clip, iso, refs

# Italian statuses of the first model; None = no override (the pipeline decides).
OLD_STATUS = {
    "In coda": "Backlog",
    "In corso": "Doing",
    "In review": "PR review",
    "Da correggere": "PR fix",
    "Serve te": None,
    "Serve una tua azione": None,
    "Fatto in integration": None,
    "Non serve": "Dropped",
}
# old values that meant "Matteo must answer": no status, but the item stays a Your call
ASKING_OLD = ("Serve te", "Serve una tua azione")
DEPLOY_RULE = {
    "atrium": "atrium container",
    "nexus": "fj deploy",
    "adlimenui": "tag",
    "ratio": "tag",
    "himalaia": "tag",
    "dotfiles": "stops at Main",
}
TAG_PATTERN = {"adlimenui": "ui/v*", "ratio": "v*", "himalaia": "v*"}
ALREADY_DONE = ("already-fixed", "already fixed")
NOT_NEEDED = ("obsolete", "not-reproduc", "not reproduc")
SUPERSEDED = ("superseded",)
DROP_REASONS = ("already done", "not needed", "superseded")
# kinds whose finished output is already in effect: a verdict, a page, an audit, an ops action
IN_EFFECT_KINDS = ("review", "docs", "ops")


def note_status(value, computed: str) -> str | None:
    """A notes `status` override in the new model, or None to keep the computed one."""
    if value in STATUSES:
        return value
    new = OLD_STATUS.get(value)
    if new == "PR review" and is_later(computed, "PR review"):
        return None
    return new


def is_later(status: str, than: str) -> bool:
    return status != "Dropped" and STATUSES.index(status) > STATUSES.index(than)


def blocked_reason(outcome: str, gates: str | None) -> str:
    rest = re.sub(r"^blocked[\s:—–-]*", "", outcome.strip(), flags=re.I).strip()
    return clip(rest or gates or "bloccata", 160)


def done_status(it: dict, outcomes: list[dict], probes) -> str:
    """Status of a finished task (ledger done / exit 0) that has no PR card of its own.

    1. Deployed when its output is already in effect: any orchestra task (a live page), or a
       review, triage, audit, research, page or ops action (kind review|docs|ops, slug review-*).
    2. Otherwise the least advanced stage (Integration/Main/Deployed) of the PRs merged into
       auto/integration that its ledger rows name ("PRs ratio#1476", "#270 synced -> merged").
    3. Otherwise Deployed only for a ledger ``done`` outcome: the task itself is complete, while
       any open PR remains visible as its own card. Other or missing outcomes return to Backlog.
    """
    short = REPOS.get(it["repo"], it["repo"])
    if (
        (it["repo"] or "orchestra") == "orchestra"
        or it["kind"] in IN_EFFECT_KINDS
        or any(s.startswith("review-") for s in it["slugs"])
    ):
        return "Deployed"
    stages = []
    for o in outcomes:
        text = " ".join(str(o.get(k) or "") for k in ("outcome", "gates", "note"))
        for repo, n in refs(text, default=short or None):
            meta = probes.pr_meta(repo).get(n, {})
            if (meta.get("state") or "").lower() == "merged":
                stages.append(merged_stage(repo, meta, probes)[0])
    if stages:
        return min(stages, key=STATUSES.index)
    return "Deployed" if lo_is_done(outcomes[-1].get("outcome", "") if outcomes else "") else "Backlog"


def lo_is_done(outcome: str) -> bool:
    """True only for the terminal success value emitted by ledger_sync."""
    return (outcome or "").strip().lower() == "done"


def deployed(short: str, commit: str, probes) -> bool | None:
    rule = DEPLOY_RULE.get(short, "")
    if rule == "tag":
        return probes.tag_contains(short, commit, TAG_PATTERN[short])
    if rule == "stops at Main":
        return True
    if rule not in ("atrium container", "fj deploy"):
        return None
    if short == "atrium":
        version = probes.atrium_version()
        if version and probes.is_ancestor(short, commit, version):
            return True
    shas = probes.deploy_shas(short)
    if shas is None:
        return False if short == "atrium" and probes.atrium_version() else None
    return any(probes.is_ancestor(short, commit, s) for s in shas)


def merged_stage(short: str, meta: dict, probes) -> tuple[str, dict]:
    stage = {"main": None, "deployed": None, "deploy_rule": DEPLOY_RULE.get(short, "")}
    commit = (meta.get("mergeCommit") or {}).get("oid", "")
    if not commit:
        return "Integration", stage
    stage["main"] = probes.main_contains(short, commit)
    if not stage["main"]:
        return "Integration", stage
    stage["deployed"] = deployed(short, commit, probes)
    return ("Deployed" if stage["deployed"] else "Main"), stage


def fixed_after_block(it: dict) -> bool:
    rev = it["review"]
    return any(
        c["slug"].endswith("-fix") and c["end"] and c["end"] > iso(rev["mtime"])
        for c in it["children"]
    )


def compute(it: dict, outcomes: list[dict], probes) -> dict:
    """{status, dropped, blocked, stage, asking}; `asking` = the state itself asks Matteo."""
    short = REPOS.get(it["repo"], it["repo"])
    res = {
        "status": "Backlog",
        "dropped": "",
        "blocked": "",
        "stage": {"main": None, "deployed": None, "deploy_rule": ""},
        "asking": False,
        "done": "",
    }
    last = outcomes[-1] if outcomes else {}
    lo = (last.get("outcome") or "").lower()
    if lo.startswith("blocked"):
        res["blocked"] = blocked_reason(last.get("outcome") or "", last.get("gates"))
    ch = it["children"]
    running = [c for c in ch if c["running"]]
    pr = it["pr"]
    meta = probes.pr_meta(short).get(pr["number"], {}) if pr else {}
    state = (meta.get("state") or (pr or {}).get("state") or "").lower()
    if pr and state == "merged":
        res["status"], res["stage"] = merged_stage(short, meta, probes)
    elif pr and state == "closed":
        res["status"] = "Dropped"
    elif pr:
        res["status"] = open_pr_status(it, meta)
        res["asking"] = "needs-human" in it["labels"]
    else:
        res["done"] = done_status(it, outcomes, probes)
        no_pr_status(it, lo, res)
    if running:
        active_status = (
            "PR review" if all("review" in c["slug"] for c in running) else "Doing"
        )
        if not (it.get('_deduped') and res['status'] != 'Dropped'
                and STATUSES.index(res['status']) > STATUSES.index(active_status)):
            res['status'] = active_status
    return res


def open_pr_status(it: dict, meta: dict) -> str:
    rev = it["review"]
    if (rev and rev["verdict"] == "BLOCK" and not fixed_after_block(it)) or meta.get(
        "mergeable"
    ) == "CONFLICTING":
        return "PR fix"
    if (rev and rev["verdict"] == "APPROVE") or meta.get(
        "reviewDecision"
    ) == "APPROVED":
        return "Merge"
    return "PR review"


def no_pr_status(it: dict, lo: str, res: dict) -> None:
    ch = it["children"]
    failed = bool(ch) and ch[-1]["exit"] not in (None, "0")
    if any(w in lo for w in ALREADY_DONE):
        res["status"], res["dropped"] = "Dropped", "already done"
    elif any(w in lo for w in SUPERSEDED):
        res["status"], res["dropped"] = "Dropped", "superseded"
    elif any(w in lo for w in NOT_NEEDED):
        res["status"], res["dropped"] = "Dropped", "not needed"
    elif lo.startswith("partial"):
        res["status"], res["asking"] = "Backlog", True
    elif lo.startswith("blocked"):
        res["status"] = "Backlog"
    elif it.get("outcomes") or any(c["exit"] == "0" for c in ch):
        if failed and not it.get("outcomes"):
            res["status"], res["asking"] = "Backlog", True
        else:
            res["status"] = res["done"]
    elif failed:
        res["status"], res["asking"] = "Backlog", True
    elif (it.get("triage") or {}).get("verdict") == "done?":
        res["asking"] = True
    if it.get("decisions"):
        res["asking"] = True


def settle(it: dict, res: dict, needs: str) -> None:
    """A curated "Niente: …" answers the item: asking states become done or dropped."""
    if not needs.startswith("Niente:"):
        return
    res["blocked"] = ""
    if not res["asking"] or it["pr"] or res["status"] not in ("Backlog", "Doing"):
        return
    if any(c["running"] for c in it["children"]):
        return
    if needs.startswith("Niente: vedi"):
        res["status"], res["dropped"] = "Dropped", "superseded"
    elif needs.startswith("Niente: non serve"):
        res["status"], res["dropped"] = "Dropped", "not needed"
    else:
        # the curator says it is done: keep a landed stage, never fall back to Doing
        res["status"] = res["done"] if res["done"] in CLOSED else "Deployed"
    res["asking"] = False


def drop_reason(res: dict, note: dict, needs: str) -> str:
    if note.get("dropped") in DROP_REASONS:
        return note["dropped"]
    if res["dropped"]:
        return res["dropped"]
    if needs.startswith("Niente: vedi"):
        return "superseded"
    if needs.startswith("Niente: già fatto"):
        return "already done"
    return "not needed"
